stage1.impression: A deep, warm night room with a strong idea (a huge rainbow armillary globe hung over the banquette, throwing a coloured shadow on the concrete), but it still reads as a competent CG render, not a photograph. The rings glow like LED neon tubes, not lit acrylic edges. The table globes are flat white identical discs, the stools and tables repeat in perfect rows, the floor is a bright, cool, hard-shadowed slab that pulls the eye, and the altar speakers at the far end burn to white. The globe makes it a specific place rather than a generic bar, but a magazine would not run it as is.

blocking_9: Mother EARF reads as lit acrylic (glowing polished rims, visible disc faces catching the spot) rather than neon hoops; hero region [620,10,870,280] lum_median >= 40 with p95 <= 200
Altar speakers hold their smoked tint and the white batts are not blown: [510,350,570,440] and [655,350,700,440] lum_p95 <= 190
Orb table lamps glow a soft smoked tint, not flat white: [795,570,845,625] lum_median between 110 and 170
The foreground floor is not the brightest large surface: [300,600,700,800] lum_median between 35 and 55, with soft, not crisp, stool shadows
Grade is warm but not orange: ceiling beams [0,0,600,120] b_median >= 26
Visible signs of life at varied tables (not one identical rocks glass per table) and readable haze in the spot cones
No smooth CG surfaces at 1:1: floor, Orb liners and wall frames show real texture

defects.what: Mother EARF's rims read as self-lit neon/LED tubes in saturated primaries; the 25 mm acrylic disc faces are almost invisible against the beams; the globe reads as a light sculpture/sign, not cast acrylic
Altar speakers burnt to near-white (p95 215-229), smoked tint lost; they read as white studio monitors
Orb lamps are flat, uniform white discs (median 206, neutral RGB 210/206/199): pasted-on, no smoke tint, no internal gradient
Floor is a bright, cool grey polished slab (median 76) with crisp stool shadows; reads as epoxy/CG and is the brightest large area in the foreground
Counter stools are exact repeated copies in a perfect row, identical back panels and brass rings
Tables repeated identically, each with one identical dark rocks glass and identical Orb: reads as a showroom set
Ceiling and beams pushed saturated orange (r 86 / b 20)
Right-hand screen reads as a blank grey-mauve canvas, flat and slightly cool against the warm wall
Back right of the zone is a dead dark block (median 13) with no detail
No visible haze in the downlight cones; air reads vacuum-clean

changes.problem: Mother EARF reads as neon hoops rather than thick lit acrylic, and the hero region is too dim for a centrepiece.

evidence.measured: lum_median 24.7, p95 117; rims uniformly self-lit, disc faces invisible at 1:1

change.setting: Mother EARF rim glow / hard spot
change.from: rim glow 0.025, hard spot 135 W cone 20 deg
change.to: rim glow 0.010, hard spot 220 W cone 24 deg

changes.expected: Rims brighten where the spot enters and dim away from it (edge light, not neon); disc faces pick up spot reflections and become legible; region median rises to about 40-50.

changes.problem: Altar speakers are burnt to white, losing the smoked tint, so the room's other EARF products read as generic monitors.
changes.expected: Speakers keep their smoke tint and batt texture; still the brightest point at the far end.

changes.problem: Orb lamps glow flat neutral white like pasted discs, not smoked acrylic with a frosted liner.
changes.expected: Orbs read as warm smoked globes with a soft core, not white plates.

changes.problem: The floor is a bright cool polished slab with crisp shadows that outshines the room and reads as CG.

evidence.measured: lum_median 76.3, falloff bins 42-92 peaking in the foreground

change.to: honed, roughness about 0.55, slightly darker warm tone

changes.expected: Foreground floor drops back into shadow, pools of light soften, eye goes to the globe and the bar.

changes.problem: The grade pushes the timber ceiling to saturated orange.
changes.expected: Warm amber timber instead of orange; concrete turns warm grey.

changes.problem: The air reads vacuum-clean: no cones under the downlights or the globe's spot.

evidence.measured: lum_p5 15.7; no visible beam in the crop

changes.expected: Faint cones under the Domes and the hard spot; shadows lift slightly in depth.

changes.problem: Each table carries the same single dark rocks glass, which reads as a showroom.

evidence.measured: four tables, identical glass in the same position

change.to: vary: nearest table a half-drunk coupe and napkin, next a record sleeve and matchbook, one table empty, one with two glasses

changes.expected: Tables read as used by different guests.

changes.problem: The right-hand screen reads as a flat, cool blank canvas against the warm wall.

evidence.measured: lum_median 69.4, RGB 86/65/63 (cooler than the wall at 137/114/88)

changes.expected: Screens sit back as dim frosted panels behind the banquette.

out_of_scope.request: Make Mother EARF's discs read as solid slotted discs, not thin hoops, and reconsider the six-colour palette in a room meant to have one source of colour
out_of_scope.why: Its shape and the six tints are EARF's product and the owner's choice (card: fixed)

out_of_scope.request: Vary the counter stools and table models so they are not identical copies
out_of_scope.why: The seats are part of the room's design as proposed (fixed); only props can break the repetition

out_of_scope.request: Give the screens content other than blank fields
out_of_scope.why: The screens and what they show are fixed
